$comment: Versioning: while shaping and before stored production documents, this schema may change in place and fixture publication does not establish compatibility. Afterwards the /1 in $id and schema const change for breaking changes; additive changes edit this file in place and bump the const in $defs/schemaRevision.
title: Recountable pull request review document
description: One generated review of a pull request. See specs/pull-request-review/review-model.md and its sibling pages. Closed lists are enumerated here; REVIEW.md may extend risk categories, so category is a pattern rather than an enum.

schema_revision.description: Date-based revision of this schema file the document was validated against, e.g. 2026-09-15 or 2026-09-15.2 for a second revision on one day.

review_exchange.description: Narrative and key facts about the review exchange.

summary.description: Narrative of the material review exchange and resulting state.

reviews.description: Number of reviews in the exchange.

back_and_forths.description: Number of back-and-forth cycles in the exchange.

critical_issues_found.description: Number of critical issues found during review.

changes_after_open.description: Commit count and summed line changes made after the pull request was opened; null when unavailable.

risk_loc.description: Lines per tier. A hunk's tier is the highest tier of the risks anchored to it; hunks in the mechanical section count as mechanical; other hunks no risk touches are unrated.

unassigned_hunks.description: Must be empty; kept so a validator can report leftovers before rejection.

required.description: Whether branch protection or rulesets require this check; null when the platform cannot read them, so the UI can decide how to present an unknown requirement.

schemaRevision.description: Date-based revision of this schema file, bumped on every additive edit. Read it at /$defs/schemaRevision/const; a document records the revision it was validated against in generator.schema_revision. Kept as a standard keyword so strict validators accept the file.
